mmu_transport_contracts.reference_behavior: MMUAvailable() and UseMMU() currently return true and do not represent disabled, unavailable, bootloader, stopped, active, updating, update-failed, or communication-fault states reliably.
non_local_evidence: Live MMU availability over hardware transport requires simulator-flow or manual-hardware-required proof
mmu_transport_contracts.known_reference_limitation: preserve-with-explicit-risk: MMUAvailable() and UseMMU() are unconditional stubs until a later intentional delta replaces them with typed runtime states.

mmu_transport_contracts.reference_behavior: HAS_MMU2, HAS_MMU2_OVER_UART, and UseMMU() influence MMU feature visibility, but runtime parity must distinguish configuration from live transport state.
non_local_evidence: Printer settings and physical MMU attachment proof remain non-local until simulator or hardware evidence exists
mmu_transport_contracts.known_reference_limitation: Configuration gates and UseMMU() do not by themselves prove live MMU availability.

mmu_transport_contracts.reference_behavior: MMU2BootloaderManager enters bootloader communication, checks firmware version, reads /internal/res/mmu/fw.bin, writes firmware pages, and records fw_up_to_date, fw_updated, flashing_error, comm_error, or not_detected results.
non_local_evidence: Bootloader serial timing and live MMU firmware update success require hardware-smoke proof
Long-run update recovery requires manual-hardware-required proof
mmu_transport_contracts.known_reference_limitation: Local source audit can verify update surfaces but cannot prove live bootloader timing or flashing success.

mmu_transport_contracts.reference_behavior: MMU2Serial uses direct UART transport when HAS_MMU2_OVER_UART is active and includes recovery handling for reboot/frame-error conditions.
non_local_evidence: UART electrical behavior, reboot recovery, and timeout behavior require hardware-smoke proof
mmu_transport_contracts.known_reference_limitation: Source audit can classify the UART path, but live MMU transport proof is non-local.

mmu_transport_contracts.reference_behavior: When HAS_PUPPIES and HAS_MMU2 are active, MMU2Serial delegates reads and writes through xBuddy Extension puppy Modbus bridge behavior instead of direct UART.
non_local_evidence: Bridge timing, accepted response state, and live MMU transport over RS485 require hardware-smoke proof
mmu_transport_contracts.known_reference_limitation: The bridge is source-backed but live bus timing is non-local evidence.

mmu_transport_contracts.reference_behavior: MMU firmware is converted into a runtime resource and exposed at /mmu/fw.bin for bootloader update code; manifests may name paths and tools but must not embed firmware contents.
non_local_evidence: Actual MMU firmware conversion and live update behavior require full-build or hardware-smoke evidence
mmu_transport_contracts.known_reference_limitation: This row records source paths and runtime resource paths only; no firmware bytes, Intel HEX contents, signing key material, serial traffic, credentials, or crash dump contents are embedded.
